name: Donut share
summary: Share-of-whole donut; slices sweep in from the pool, tap a slice for its readout.

slots.label: Center number
slots.tooltip: The big word or number in the hole of the donut, like a year or a total

slots.label: Center note
slots.tooltip: A short line under the center number that says what the donut shows

slots.label: Slices
slots.tooltip: The parts of the whole. Each slice gets a name and a size; sizes are shown as percentages of their total

item.label: Name
item.tooltip: What this slice stands for, shown next to it with its percentage

item.label: Size
item.tooltip: How big this slice is. Any scale works: each slice is drawn as its share of all the sizes added up

item.label: Colour
item.tooltip: Pick a colour for this slice, or leave it empty to take the next colour after the slide's

props.label: Colour
props.tooltip: The slide's accent colour: the first slice and the center number wear it

provenance.note: The demo is the authored EOS-001 data, carried.
